items.reason: Describes the same non-atomic count-and-insert race that allows concurrent requests to exceed the device limit.

Targets the cost of the full COUNT query, whereas #09 targets synchronous device tagging during authentication. Making the count cheaper would leave synchronous database operations in the authentication path; the every-request claim also overlooks the device cache.
Describes mutation of the captured argument slice across callback retries, causing repeated SQL prepending and invalid UPDATE arguments. No golden issue describes this retry problem.
